spans.s:
देश देश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. दिश्), any place
or spot shown or pointed out; place or spot in
general, region, country (whether inhabited or unin-
habited, e. g. देशम् आवस् or निविश्, to settle in a place;
आत्मीय-देश, one's own country); a province, part,
department, side, portion; an institute, ordinance; देश
occurs at the end of some comps., the fem. ending in
आ; [cf. अ-द्˚, एक-द्˚, वि-द्˚, &c.]
—देश-काल, औ,
m. du. place and time.
—देश-कालज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्,
knowing the (proper) place and time.
—देश-
काल-विद्, त्, त्, त्, knowing place and time.
—देश-
काल-विभाग, अस्, m. apportioning of place and time.
—देश-काल-व्यवस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, regulated by
place and time.
—देश-ज or देश-जात, अस्, आ, अम्,
‘country-born,’ native, indigenous; born in the right
place; produced in the right country (as a horse, ele-
[]
phant, &c.); of genuine descent; genuine; [cf. देश्य.]
—देश-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the district, familiar
with places.
—देश-दृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, seen or
experienced in a country; customary in a country;
considered locally, judged as to place.
—देश-धर्म,
अस्, m. local law, local rights or customs, the law or
usage of any country.
—देश-निर्णय, अस्, m.
‘description of countries,’ N. of a work.
—देश-
भाषा, f. the dialect of a country.
—देश-भ्र-
मण, अम्, n. wandering about, peregrination, tour.
—देश-राज-चरित, अम्, n. ‘history of native
princes,’ N. of a work.
—देश-रूप, अम्, n. ‘the
being in the right place,’ conformity with place, pro-
priety, fitness.
—देश-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, residing in a
country.
—देश-वृत्त, अम्, n. a circle depending
upon its relative position with regard to the spot
from which it is observed.
—देश-व्यवहार, अस्,
m. local usage, custom of the country.
—देश-स्थ,
अस्, आ, अम्, situated or living in a country.
—देशा-
चार (˚श-आच्˚), अस्, m. local usage or custom.
—दे-
शातिथि (˚श-अत्˚), इस्, m. ‘a guest in a country,’ a
foreigner.
—देशान्तर (˚श-अन्˚), अम्, n. another
country, abroad, foreign parts; longitude or difference
of longitude; the distance from the chief meridian.
—देशान्तर-फल, अम्, n. the equation for dif-
ference of meridian.
—देशान्तर-भाण्डानयन
(˚ड-आन्˚), अम्, n. importing wares from foreign coun-
tries.
—देशान्तरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, belonging to another
country, foreign, a foreigner.
—देशापेक्ष (˚श-
अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, spying or inspecting a land.

देशक, अस्, इका, अम्, who or what shows, points
out, describes, directs, teaches, &c.; a shower, indi-
cator; (अस्), m. a ruler, governor; a guide, instructor.
देशना, f. direction, command, instruction, doctrine.

देशित, अस्, आ, अम्, directed, commanded; shown,
pointed out; advised, instructed.

देशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, showing, pointing out, instructing,
guiding; of or belonging to a country; (इनी), f. the
index or fore-finger.

देशी, f., scil. भाषा, the dialect of a country; N.
of a Rāgiṇī, (according to Hanu-mat) wife of the
Rāga Dīpaka.
—देशी-कोष, अस्, m. a vocabulary of
the dialect of a country.

देशीय, अस्, आ, अम्, peculiar or belonging to a
country or province, provincial, native; (at the end
of a comp.) inhabiting any country (e. g. मागध-
देशीयस्, an inhabitant of Māgadha); bordering upon,
contiguous, not very distant from, almost (in this
sense regarded by Indian grammarians as an affix,
see पञ्च-वर्षक-द्˚, पटु-द्˚, &c.).
—देशीय-
भाषा, f. the dialect of a country, native dialect.
—देशीय-वराडी, N. of a Rāga ?; (also read देशी-
वराडी.)

देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pointed out, to be ordered
or proved; being in a place or on the spot, present
at any transaction (and so witnessing it); belonging
to or being in a country, local, provincial, inhabiting
or coming from a country, (often at the end of a comp.,
e. g. नाना-द्˚, coming from various countries; तद्-द्˚,
inhabiting the same country); born in or belonging
to one's own country, native; born at the right place
or in the right country, of genuine descent; genuine
[cf. देश-ज]; contiguous, not far from, almost [cf.
देशीय above, and see वितस्ति-द्˚, शिशु-द्˚, पटु-द्˚,
&c.]; (अस्), m. an eye-witness of anything, one who
was on the spot; the inhabitant of a country; (अम्),
n. the proposition, the statement or exhibition of a
question or argument; the fact or thing to be proved
or substantiated; [cf. अ-द्˚.]
—देश्य-भिक्षु, उस्,
m. a native mendicant.

देष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pointed out or shown
or declared.

देष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who shows or directs or
points out, an indicator; (ट्री), f., N. of a divine
female (= धर्माद्य्-उपदेश-कर्त्री).
देष्ट्र, अम्, n., Ved. direction, order; promise.

देशकारी देशकारी, f., N. of a Rāgiṇī or
[]
musical mode, (according to Hanu-mat) the wife of
the Rāga Megha; [cf. देव-किरी.]

देशाख देशाख and देशाग, अस्, m., N. of
a Rāga; (ई), f., N. of a Rāgiṇī.

देष्ठ देष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. fr. 1. दा),
Ved. giving the most, most liberal, greatest giver.

देष्ण, अम्, n., Ved. giving, a gift; [cf. कु-
मार-द्˚, चारु-द्˚, तुवि-द्˚.]
1. देष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, liberal, giving, a donor.

देष्णु 2. देष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. 3. दा or 4. दा ?),
difficult of subjection, intractable, ungovernable.

देष्णु 3. देष्णु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. 7. दा), a
washerman.
